flyer.justification: The flyer adheres strictly to formatting guidelines including title length constraints and accurately captures key themes from the talk.

instagram.justification: The Instagram caption includes an engaging hook, carousel visual cues, clean emoji usage, a clear call to action, and exactly 10 relevant hashtags.

linkedin.justification: The draft fails format requirements by merely pasting the opening sentences of the transcript verbatim without structuring, insights, a call to action, or hashtags.

summary.justification: The executive summary perfectly organizes the core points into the required sections and stays well under the 400-word limit.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all structural guidelines, maintaining an engaging editorial tone and keeping the subject line under 50 characters.

blog.justification: The blog post is exceptionally well written, adhering to all structural requirements including numbered insight sections, a comparison table, and an About the Author section.
